decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8am to 6pm monday to saturday.
Condition : 3 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times 8am to 6pm moday to saturday.
Condition : 4 - Details of refuse storage shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and implemented as approved within one month of the date of this permission.

Condition : 5 - Details of fume extraction and ventilation systems shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and implemented as approved within one month of the date of this permission.

Condition : 6 - Details of a soundproofing scheme for protecting adjoining residential occupiers from excessive internally generated noise shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme should be completed within 3 months of the date of this permission.

Condition : 7 - Details of level threshold for the front entrance door shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme should be completed within 3 months of the date of this permission.

Condition : 8 - The premises shall be used for the preparation and service of food and drinks for consumption on the premises and there shall be no sale of food or drinks for consumption off the premises.
description: Continued use of premises as cafe (A3).
